title: Chris Heller - Ten Years of Weird Alternatives (EP.420)

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: Chris Heller is the Co-Founder of Cordillera Investment Partners, a $1.6 billion manager of non-correlated, niche investments.
reader_summary.overview: Chris Heller is the Co-Founder of Cordillera Investment Partners, a $1.6 billion manager of non-correlated, niche investments, or weird alternatives. Cordillera looks for investments ahead of the crowd that offer compelling returns and significant diversification. Chris came on the podcast two years ago in our Manager Meeting series interviewed by FEG's Greg Dowling, and that conversation is replayed in the feed.

key_points.text: Our follow-up covers lessons learned over ten years of focusing on off-the-run investments.
We reflect on Cordillera's strategy, sourcing funnel, research, operating partners, deal structures, and risk management.
We then discuss the importance of people, humility, and struggle in investment success.
